title: NoFastBoats
description: This mod just reduces speed of boat on packed ice and blue ice (specially to disable hyperloops)
body:
Perhaps you want to prevent the use of Hyperloops in the Nether on your SMP server? But you still want boats to travel just as fast on the other two types of ice?
This mod is for you.

What's new:
* When attempting to ride on Blue Ice or Packed Ice, your boat's speed drops to the standard speed for any solid block
* The other two types of ice remain unchanged—you can ride them freely

Thanks to the Ice Boat Nerf mod for the inspiration, and for the fact that there was no port to NeoForge
